section_title: 2. Introduction of the Five-Year Capital Improvement Plan and request for direction on utilizing excess
text: None. Project Management Services in an amount of $4,398,229, for the Fire Stations #27 and #29 Replacement Project (CIP No. 1410) Resolution No. 11833 City Manager Benoun provided introductory remarks and project background. City Engineer Miki Tsubota gave the presentation. The presentation is on file with the City Clerk. No one from the audience requested to speak. Council members asked clarifying questions and engaged in discussion. Council Member Little moved, and Vice Mayor Jorgens seconded, to adopt a resolution authorizing an agreement with Macks Craic, Inc., dba Mack5. The motion passed, 5 AYES. Measure GG and Measure LL funding with respect to the Central Avenue Overpass Project or the Cultural Arts Center Project City Manager Benoun provided introductory remarks and requested that Council provide direction to staff based on the options outlined below: Option 1 (Staff Recommendation): • Suspend Overpass Project and work to reallocate funds to other viable City projects • Refine funding analysis to pay for the Cultural Arts Center Option 2: • Refine funding analysis to pay for the Overpass Project • No Cultural Arts Center project Thursday, March 26, 2026, Regular Meeting Minutes Page 2 of 4 Option 3: • Suspend Overpass Project and work to reallocate funds to other viable City projects. • No Cultural Arts Center project. • Refine funding analysis for alternative projects City Engineer Miki Tsubota gave the presentation. The presentation is on file with the City Clerk. No one from the audience requested to speak. Council members asked clarifying questions, engaged in discussion, and provided direction to staff. Mayor Hannon moved, Council Member Little seconded, not to proceed with the Central Avenue overpass project. The motion passed, 4 Ayes, with Council Member Grindall opposed Mayor Hannon moved, Vice Mayor Grindall seconded, to approve the Option 1 directing staff to proceed with issuing RFPs and hiring a consultant, using a project budget of up to $63 million based on Concept C. Staff will return with a refined project plan, updated cost analysis, revenue feasibility, programming options, and integration into the Five-Year CIP. The motion passed, 5 AYES. Staff will prepare a list of prioritized transportation and infrastructure improvements for Council review, along with recommendations for ACTC fund allocations and reallocations at a future meeting.

She will volunteer at Family Day in the Park, noting the egg hunt schedule: adaptive needs at 10:00 a.m., and hunts for ages 4 and under and 5+ at 10:30 a.m. Vice Mayor Jorgens highlighted Newark’s early baseball history, noting the 1900s Wedgewoods mostly local iron workers - who played across the Bay Area and celebrated the 1910 Dumbarton Rail Bridge opening, helping shape the city’s community pride.
